ModMetaData.name: Stack Behaviour Overhaul
ModMetaData.author: Sir Rolin
ModMetaData.description:
Stack damage is carried through the stack: each time an item's health is depleted, one item is removed and remaining damage carries over. When part of a damaged stack is split off, the stack left behind is restored to full health. Combining damaged stacks adds their damage instead of averaging it, potentially consuming items. Explosion damage received by stackable items scales with the affected stack size and a configurable setting.
Known side effect: market value is calculated from the health of the whole stack. Removing an item from a damaged stack can therefore increase the remaining stack's sale value compared with selling the original stack at the same percentage of health.
